mathcounts-potw-2026-06-08-02.title: Per week
mathcounts-potw-2026-06-08-02.body:
Each week: $85 + 15 = 100$ dollars (three workshops cost the 15-dollar package price, cheaper than $3 \times 5.50 = 16.50$). Six weeks: $600$ dollars.

**Answer: 600 dollars**

mathcounts-potw-2026-06-08-03.title: Set up equations
mathcounts-potw-2026-06-08-03.body:
Lailan pays $6(85 + 15) = 600$ dollars, so Ailee's camps total $s + b + c = 600$. Cheerleading is one-fourth: $c = 150$, so $s + b = 450$. With $b = s + 100$: $2s + 100 = 450$, $s = 175$, $b = 275$.

**Answer: 275 dollars**

mathcounts-potw-2026-06-08-03.title: Half-difference trick
mathcounts-potw-2026-06-08-03.body:
Soccer and band together cost $600 - \frac14(600) = 450$ and differ by 100. The larger is $\frac{450 + 100}{2} = 275$.

**Answer: 275 dollars**
